What We Make

From single-unit prototypes to multi-thousand retail runs — we sculpt, cast and hand-paint every kind of custom resin figurine you can imagine.

Mascot Figurines

Bring your brand mascot to life as a hand-painted resin figure — perfect for retail, sports teams, IP licensing.

Designer Toys / Art Toys

Limited-run designer toys for galleries, conventions and indie artist drops.

Statues & GK Kits

1/8 to 1/4 scale resin statues, polystone display pieces and unpainted GK kits for collectors.

Blind Box Series

Full blind-box series production — sculpting, mold, casting, painting, packaging and inner-tray.

Bobbleheads

Custom bobbleheads from a photo or sketch — corporate gifting, sports promos, fan merch.

Resin Keychains

Mini resin charms and keychains for retail blind packs, brand campaigns and event giveaways.

Dioramas & Display Bases

Themed dioramas, display bases and environment props that lift any figure from good to gallery-worthy.

Bulk Production

Multi-thousand-unit runs with full QA, packaging and worldwide shipping.

Have something specific in mind?

Send us your concept and our sculptors will reply with a free 3D mock-up and quote within 24 hours.
